items.description: Sebkha Tindouf is an expansive seasonal salt lake located on the border region, characterized by its arid, flat salt pans.
Sidi Boughaba is a coastal freshwater lagoon and a significant Ramsar site, providing a refuge for migratory birds.
Bin el Ouidane is a large artificial reservoir in the Middle Atlas, known for its scenic views and water activities.
The Oued Guir is an important river system in southeastern Morocco, flowing through arid landscapes towards the Sahara.
The Oued Noun river flows through southern Morocco, shaping the landscape and supporting local oases and vegetation.
The Oued Ed-Dahab area is a unique coastal landscape in southern Morocco, dominated by desert and Atlantic ocean influences.
The Oued Massa river and its national park create a protected wetland sanctuary on the Atlantic coast, rich in birdlife.
Cap Ghir is a prominent headland on the Atlantic coast, known for its rugged cliffs and sweeping ocean views.
The Oued Nfiss is a river in the High Atlas region, essential for water supply and irrigation in the Marrakech area.
The Tansift river estuary is a coastal area where the river meets the Atlantic, creating a diverse wetland habitat.
Cap Spartel is a headland near Tangier that marks the point where the Atlantic Ocean meets the Mediterranean Sea.
The Oued Noun valley is a distinct geographical feature in southern Morocco, characterized by its arid terrain and historic oases.
Figuig is an isolated oasis town surrounded by rugged mountain ranges in the remote eastern reaches of Morocco.
The hills surrounding the holy town of Moulay Idriss offer beautiful vistas and a unique landscape near the ruins of Volubilis.
The Tensift valley is a broad basin extending from the High Atlas towards the Atlantic, supporting intensive agriculture.
The High Plateaus are a vast, elevated semi-arid region in eastern Morocco, forming part of the inland steppe landscape.
